title: SCPN Z-Pinch Core
description: Governed device-family repository for the z-pinch and sheared-flow z-pinch configurations within the SCPN Reactor Systems Research Group. Evidence maturity computational_prototype: a validated device configuration model, diagnostic and clock semantics aligned with the SCPN Phase Orchestrator observability catalogue, level-0 device physics (Bennett equilibrium, ideal-MHD growth estimates with the Kadomtsev criterion, the Shumlak-Hartman sheared-flow criterion and the Pease-Braginskii current), and tessellated and B-rep device models with STL, glTF and STEP exports. All parameter sets are synthetic; no real machine is described, and the claim inventory is empty.
